title: Construction documents.
officialText: Any temporary installation utilizing the exemptions and load reductions in the structural design shall be prominently indicated on drawings as temporary, and all reduced loads shall be indicated on the drawings. The environmental load mitigations shall be indicated on the construction documents. The construction documents shall be maintained at the site of the temporary installation and be available to the department upon request.
